scope: Final fitting/export only; no upload or new model selection.

raw.precision: original FP32 weights + bfloat16 MPS autocast
raw.support: all applicable training rows; no sampling

corrector.init_score: logit of complete full-training 3-fold raw OOF; clip1e-7

artifact_contract.test_ids: official PassengerId Unicode strings in original order
artifact_contract.model: model.joblib is a descriptor binding raw_model.joblib/residual_booster.txt/residual_schema.json; inference requires the named two runtimes

runtime.execution: four sequential fresh child processes under shared parent 3600s deadline

verification.official_submission_validation: kaggle_workflow.validate_submission complete rows, unique official PassengerId order, columns, literal booleans; recheck SHA before publish
verification.existing_attempt_deduplication: Reject CSV SHA found in any reports/**/online_attempts/*.json both in CPU stage and before publication
verification.gpu_positive_class: All native Nx2 predict_proba outputs select column1 before scalar probability validation

limitations: Final OOF is a supervised stacking training input, not an additional validation estimate.
The 8693-label final model includes previously excluded holdout rows by explicit final-fit authorization.
Existing development metrics remain adaptive; no stable-superiority claim.
No submission authorization is generated; root decides separately when Kaggle quota permits.
